class.name: RDAccelerationStructureGeometry
class.description: [RDAccelerationStructureGeometry] describes the geometry data used to build a Bottom-Level Acceleration Structure (BLAS) in [method RenderingDevice.blas_create]. Two geometry types are supported, selected via [member geometry_type]: - [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES]: triangle mesh geometry defined by [member vertex_buffer] and an optional [member index_buffer]. - [constant TYPE_AABBS]: procedural axis-aligned bounding box geometry defined by [member aabb_buffer], used for custom intersection shaders. Only the members relevant to the active [member geometry_type] are used when building the acceleration structure.

members.member: Buffer containing axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs). Each AABB is stored as two [Vector3] values: the minimum and maximum corners, packed as [code skip-lint]float[/code] values. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_AABBS].
Number of AABBs in [member aabb_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_AABBS].
Byte offset of the first AABB in [member aabb_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_AABBS].
Number of bytes between each AABB entry in [member aabb_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_AABBS].

The type of geometry described by this object. Set to [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES] for triangle mesh geometry or [constant TYPE_AABBS] for procedural AABB geometry. Only the members relevant to the active type are used when building the acceleration structure. See [enum Type].
Buffer containing vertex indices. If [code]null[/code], triangles are non-indexed. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Number of indices used by this geometry in [member index_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Byte offset of the first index in [member index_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Buffer containing vertex positions. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Number of vertices used by this geometry in [member vertex_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Format of the vertices in [member vertex_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Byte offset of the first vertex in [member vertex_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].
Number of bytes between each vertex in [member vertex_buffer]. Active when [member geometry_type] is [constant TYPE_TRIANGLES].

constants.constant: The geometry is defined as a triangle mesh. Use the [code]vertex_*[/code] and [code]index_*[/code] members to describe the mesh data.

The geometry is defined as a set of axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs). Use the [code]aabb_*[/code] members to describe the AABB data. Requires a custom intersection shader in the raytracing pipeline.
